mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, blocking fentanyl metabolism and increasing serotonin levels, creating risk for serotonin syndrome and severe CNS depression with respiratory compromise.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, reduce fentanyl dose significantly, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms and respiratory depression, and maintain minimum 14-day washout after phenelzine discontinuation.
